methodology.scope: Human review of all 50 sampled descriptions and every skill emitted in the existing sample report.
methodology.matching_policy: Each emitted skill was checked against its short verbatim source context. Missed skills were limited to clearly present names/aliases in the existing canonical taxonomy.
methodology.limitations: Small sample; records were sampled for the prior extraction check and were not independently annotated before extraction. Results are not a formal or statistically representative accuracy estimate.

qualitative_assessment.precision_in_this_sample: No clear false positives were identified in the reviewed emitted mentions.
qualitative_assessment.missed_skill_concentration: No clear missed canonical taxonomy skills were identified.
qualitative_assessment.systematic_issue: No obvious systematic issue was observed in this sample. Ambiguous short tokens such as C and Go appeared in non-skill contexts and were not emitted.
